display.purpose: The one question at the top of Discover.

cook-step.purpose: Step text in cook mode, read from arm's length.

hand.purpose: Warm notes only: greetings, signposts, encouragement, empty states.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Photos, round actions, the heart and the pinned bar only.

motion.name: spring
motion.purpose: Press feedback with a small overshoot.

motion.name: glide
motion.purpose: Settling highlights and layout, no overshoot.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one big action per screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #B7D3A0; color: #2B2A24; font-family: Rubik, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 16px; min-height: 56px; padding: 0 24px; border: none; border-radius: 999px; transition: transform .15s; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3A5E30; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Pill
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 18px; border-radius: 18px; background: #EDE7DA; color: #59574C; font: 500 15px Rubik, sans-serif; margin-right: 8px; } .ds-pill-on { background: #B7D3A0; color: #2B2A24; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Amount Tag
components.description: Amounts, times and temperatures inside step text.
components.html: Stir in the coconut milk 1 can and simmer 10 min.
components.css: .ds-step { font: 16px/24px Rubik, sans-serif; color: #2B2A24; } .ds-step b { color: #3A5E30; } .ds-tag { display: inline-block; padding: 0 6px; border: 1.5px solid rgba(43,42,36,.1); border-radius: 8px; background: #EFE6D3; font: 500 15px Rubik, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Round Action
components.description: Save, This week, Grocery list under a recipe title.
components.css: .ds-round { width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 50%; border: none; background: #F7F3EA; color: #5E8B4E; box-shadow: 0px 10px 22px -12px rgba(60,52,32,.14); margin-right: 12px; } .ds-round-on { background: #5E8B4E; color: #fff; }

narrative.overview: Cooking is a walk, not a test: recipes along a trail, journeys hiked from easy to summit, sand paper with garden greens and ink drawings, a small tuxedo cat for company in cook mode and on journeys. A calm kitchen tool, not a feed.
keyCharacteristics: Serif names, Rubik facts, handwriting for warmth

rules.name: The Food Comes First Rule
rules.body: No blues or saturated accents near food.

rules.name: The Ink On Fill Rule
rules.body: Small text is dark ink; Deep Moss is the only colored text.

rules.name: The Feelings, Not Facts Rule
rules.body: Handwriting only for warmth; anything to act on is in Rubik.

rules.name: The Photos Float Rule
rules.body: Only photos and floating controls get a shadow.

dos: Do keep one primary action per screen
Do put amounts, times and temperatures in tags
Do give every motion a Reduce Motion fallback
donts: Don't show the cat outside cook mode and journeys
Don't add streaks, badges or rewards
